description: Send execTransaction for a request that has reached its threshold (the agent key pays gas). Simulates first and refuses on missing/invalid signatures, or when no owner other than the agent has approved. Irreversible: confirm with the user first.

chainId.description: EVM chain id, e.g. 11155111 for Sepolia (see list_networks)

name: execute_request
title: Execute a request on-chain
